## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] Behaviour changes are reflected in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] User-facing docs (`README.md`, `Docs/`, `targets/README.md`) updated if needed.
- [ ] No runtime state committed (`config.json`, `color_calibration.json`, `cache/`).
- [ ] If this adds UI or drawing behaviour, I ran it on Windows.
